intro: 12 個應徵與面試情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: The designer's ability was obvious from her portfolio.
ex.zh: 從這位設計師的作品集就看得出她的能力。

ex.en: The ability to work with others is a key requirement.
ex.zh: 與他人共事的能力是一項關鍵要求。

note: the ability to V,後接不定詞

ex.en: The college graduate applied for three jobs and received three offers.
ex.zh: 這位大學畢業生應徵了三份工作,收到三個錄取通知。

ex.en: Everyone who is interested should apply in person at any branch office.
ex.zh: 有興趣者皆可親自前往任一分公司應徵。

note: apply for a job 應徵工作;apply to a school 申請學校
applicant 應徵者;application 申請書

ex.en: Your background in the publishing industry is a definite asset for this job.
ex.zh: 你在出版業的背景,對這份工作絕對是加分。

ex.en: The employer did a complete background check before offering him the job.
ex.zh: 雇主在錄取他之前做了完整的背景調查。

note: background check 背景調查;a background in sth
a person's experience, education, and family history

ex.en: The young woman was so excited when she was called in for an interview that she told everyone she knew.
ex.zh: 這位年輕女子接到面試通知時非常興奮,告訴了所有認識的人。

ex.en: The human resources manager called in all the qualified applicants for a second interview.
ex.zh: 人資經理把所有合格的應徵者都找來進行第二次面試。

ex.en: Good applicants show confidence during an interview.
ex.zh: 優秀的應徵者在面試時會展現自信。

ex.en: He had too much confidence and thought that the job was his.
ex.zh: 他過於自信,以為這份工作非他莫屬。

note: confident 有自信的;confidential 機密的

ex.en: The company is constantly looking for highly trained employees.
ex.zh: 這家公司不斷在尋找訓練有素的員工。

ex.en: Martin constantly checked his messages to see if anyone had called for an interview.
ex.zh: 馬丁不斷查看訊息,看有沒有人通知他面試。

note: on a continual basis、happening all the time

ex.en: Our department head is an expert in financing.
ex.zh: 我們的部門主管是融資方面的專家。

ex.en: The candidate demonstrated that he was an expert in marketing.
ex.zh: 這位候選人展現出自己是行銷方面的專家。

note: an expert in / on / at sth
expertise 專業知識;expertly 熟練地

ex.en: Always follow up an interview with a thank-you note.
ex.zh: 面試後一定要寄感謝函作為後續聯繫。

ex.en: As a follow-up, the candidate sent the company a list of references.
ex.zh: 作為後續動作,這位候選人寄給公司一份推薦人名單。

note: 動詞分開 follow up;名詞加連字號 follow-up
follow up on sth 追蹤某事的後續

ex.en: Marla was hesitant about negotiating a higher salary.
ex.zh: 瑪拉對於爭取更高的薪水感到遲疑。

ex.en: The recent college graduate was hesitant about accepting his first offer.
ex.zh: 這位剛畢業的大學生對於接受第一個錄取通知有所遲疑。

note: be hesitant about / to V 對⋯遲疑

ex.en: It is very important to act professionally during a job interview.
ex.zh: 面試時表現專業非常重要。

ex.en: We had to interview a lot of people before we found the right one for the job.
ex.zh: 我們面試了很多人,才找到適合這份工作的人選。

note: interviewer 面試官;interviewee 受試者

ex.en: The human resources director presents each candidate's résumé to the department supervisor for review.
ex.zh: 人資主管把每位候選人的履歷呈給部門主管審閱。

ex.en: The candidate presented her qualifications so well that the employer offered her a job on the spot.
ex.zh: 這位候選人把自己的條件呈現得極好,雇主當場就錄取了她。

note: 動詞重音在後 /prɪˈzent/;名詞重音在前 /ˈprezənt/

ex.en: Her hands trembled and she spoke weakly at the interview.
ex.zh: 她在面試時雙手發抖,說話有氣無力。

ex.en: She wrote so weakly we couldn't read it.
ex.zh: 她字寫得太淡,我們看不清楚。

note: weakly 虛弱地;weekly 每週地,發音相同
weak 虛弱的;weaken 使變弱;weakness 弱點
